observations.behavior: Removes a large, now-obsolete set of action ID constants and their usage, replacing them with a shared, centrally-defined HOME_ACTION_IDS. This could reduce duplication and prevent future mismatches between the Home tab and the action handler.
observations.posthog_connection: The Slack App Home tab uses a set of action IDs to route user clicks. P1.F1.H3 removes the local definition of these IDs and instead relies on HOME_ACTION_IDS, which is defined elsewhere. This could help maintain consistency between the tab and the action handler, and could help prevent future mismatches between the Home tab and the action handler.

observations.behavior: Replaces a fallback that could return an arbitrary candidate with a deterministic fallback to the oldest candidate, and adds a None check before calling the handler. This could prevent unexpected behavior when no integration is resolved.
